title: platform-checklist + NORTH-STAR: retire `records-forms.picklist-org-append` and the "customers append values per organization" promise — the per-organization picklist append is ruled out
body:
Filing gate: ③ — maintainer direct order.

Provenance: the maintainer, live PM chat in session `session_01EgxC4UNYnzhuvmG12fh5A8`, 2026-10-11, verbatim: 「按组织追加 picklist 值，不考虑」, given while executing the order 「该关的关，改开卡的开卡」 on the open `pm:epic` cards. Parent context: #18164 (the picklist epic, closed in the same act with a pointer here).

## What is wrong

Two declarations still promise a capability the maintainer has ruled out. Readings on `main` at `8532783f`:

- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json:4372`: item `records-forms.picklist-org-append`, `"status": "planned"`, P2, titled "An organization appends a value to a shared picklist without changing the app source: that organization can write it, and another organization is refused". Its sibling `records-forms.picklist-shared-across-objects` cross-references it (`:4357`: "the verification sentence that this item and records-forms.picklist-org-append split between them"), and `docs/qa/platform-checklist/coverage.json` names it.
- `docs/NORTH-STAR.md:43`: the functional point 「共享选项集:多个对象复用同一份选项,客户按组织追加值而不改应用源码」, listing `picklist-shared-across-objects, picklist-org-append`.

ADR-0131 D6 had already retired the per-organization overlay axis the item depended on (`docs/adr/0131-total-organization-ownership-no-null-organization-id.md:105`: "ADR-0005's per-organization overlay axis is retired").

## Change

1. Retire `records-forms.picklist-org-append` using the checklist's own convention (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/README.md:49`: `active | draft | planned | retired`; read its "Implementation status" section first). Update the cross-reference in `picklist-shared-across-objects` and `coverage.json` so they agree.
2. Rewrite `docs/NORTH-STAR.md:43` to the capability that exists: shared option sets reused across objects (the phase-1 `picklist` kind, #19518 / #19519, Studio objectui#10202). Drop the per-organization append clause and the retired id.
3. Run the gates `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives for this file surface.

⛔ No product code. ⛔ Do not re-scope the append to environment level. The ruling drops it rather than moving it.

## Who acts

The `domain:skills` seat, which owns the governed face `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`. The `docs/qa/**` hunk rides the same PR because the two must agree in one commit. Tier H: the maintainer merges.

## Dedup

MCP issue search over objectstack-ai/objectstack, open and closed, query "picklist org append organization appends value shared picklist retire checklist item": 5 hits. They are #18164 (the parent, closed in this act), and #19518, #19519, #21018 and #21957, all closed. None of them retires the item.

Refs: #18164 · ADR-0131 D6.
